description: Writes a reply a business owner can post under a customer review on Google, Yelp, Facebook, TripAdvisor or Trustpilot. Use it when someone shares a review of their business and wants a response to it, including angry or negative reviews. The reply follows the star rating: it thanks happy customers, and for low ratings it acknowledges the problem without arguing and offers to make it right. It does not post anything anywhere; the owner copies the reply and posts it themselves. It does not write reviews.

alternate.description: Set true to get a differently worded version of a reply already written for the same review.

business_name.description: Name of the business being reviewed.

business_type.description: What kind of business it is, e.g. "dentist", "pizza restaurant", "plumber".

length.description: concise is 1 to 2 sentences, standard 2 to 3, detailed 3 to 4. Defaults to standard.

owner_notes.description: Facts or wishes the owner gave for this reply, e.g. "we fixed the AC last week" or "sign off as Maria". Only include what the owner actually said.

platform.description: Where the review was posted. Defaults to google.

review_text.description: The review exactly as the customer wrote it. Leave out for a rating with no text.

reviewer_name.description: The reviewer's display name, if shown. Leave out if unknown; the reply will not invent one.

star_rating.description: Star rating the customer gave, 1 to 5.

tone.description: Voice of the reply. Defaults to friendly.

name: write_review_reply
title: Write a review reply
